summary: Phase E freeze registry for legacy workflow mutation boundaries that remain outside the orchestrator command adapter drain.

counterContract.notes: Every legacy boundary records an attempted invocation before guards and mutation transactions. The injective boundary id counts rejected guards and non-transition mutations as well as committed transitions.

boundaries.title: Agent task workflow endpoint
boundaries.triggerSurface: Native PM task workflow callback for assignee/reviewer workflow actions.
boundaries.actorSource: Authenticated native PM callback token resolved to the durable agent or human principal named by the workflow turn.
boundaries.authorizationAndGuards: Canonical task command authorization, assignment/reviewer authority, expected workflow version, plan, prerequisite, Epic, WIP, branch, cycle, and procedure guards.
boundaries.idempotencyIdentity: Task id plus public action, PM message id, execution run/cycle evidence, and the route's stable action-specific idempotency key.
boundaries.replacementCommand: Normalized TaskWorkflowCommand submitted by submitAuthoritativeAgentWorkflowAction; durable legacy ownership remains a separately fenced drain only.
stateTouched: formal blocker and checkpoint permission state
boundaries.phaseEMigrationDestination: Task workflow command adapter backed by lib/tasks/orchestrator submitWorkflowCommand.

instrumentation.kind: task.move payload via/source or route activity kind

boundaries.responseParity: Preserve JSON workflow responses, validation errors, episode budget fields, and silent/visible reply routing.
boundaries.sideEffectParity: Preserve idempotency, comments, activity rows, outbox effects, repository handoff, checklist updates, blocker controls, board invalidation, and wake behavior.

boundaries.title: Agent epic workflow endpoint
boundaries.triggerSurface: Native PM epic workflow callback for completion review, deploy review, manager queueing, and task requests.
boundaries.actorSource: Authenticated native PM callback token resolved to the Epic reviewer, deploy reviewer, acting manager, reporter, or mechanical service principal.
boundaries.authorizationAndGuards: Epic reviewer/manager authority, Epic status and deployment state, approved-plan and dependency rules, child-task command authorization, and expected task workflow versions.
boundaries.idempotencyIdentity: Epic id plus public action, PM message id, relevant completion/deploy review revision, and deterministic child-task command keys.
boundaries.replacementCommand: Typed Epic workflow adapter with canonical child TaskWorkflowCommand fanout and exact repository/deployment callbacks.
stateTouched: child Task status via transition kernel
boundaries.phaseEMigrationDestination: Epic workflow command adapter plus child-task command dispatch.

instrumentation.kind: task.move payload via/source or epic activity kind

boundaries.responseParity: Preserve scoped-token JSON responses and comment/action-plan routing for reviewer/manager turns.
boundaries.sideEffectParity: Preserve child task rank movement, approval reset, generated comments, queue assignment, outbox effects, and Epic status/deploy status activity.

boundaries.title: Review submission and repository validation handoff
boundaries.triggerSurface: ready_for_review workflow action, repository verification callback, and branch-pushed verifier utility.
boundaries.actorSource: Authenticated assignee submission or mechanical repository executor callback with server-resolved identity.
boundaries.authorizationAndGuards: Assignee authority, open-checklist and repository-contract guards, plus exact task/cycle/procedure/step/repository-run/candidate/base SHA callback correlation.
boundaries.idempotencyIdentity: Submission receipt or exact repository callback tuple including task, cycle, procedure, step, repository run, candidate SHA, and base SHA.
boundaries.replacementCommand: submit_candidate_for_review command and repository_validation_succeeded/failed mechanical callback commands; legacy-v1 drain stays ownership-fenced.
boundaries.phaseEMigrationDestination: Submit-candidate-for-review procedure adapter and repository validation callback command.

instrumentation.kind: task.move payload via/source or repository activity kind

boundaries.responseParity: Preserve ready_for_review responses, repository validation outcome mapping, and callback rejection behavior.
boundaries.sideEffectParity: Preserve candidate SHA/base SHA capture, review lease invalidation/upsert, outbox effects, reviewer wakes, and reporter alerting.

boundaries.title: Review decision and repository finalization
boundaries.triggerSurface: review_done/review_feedback, repository finalization jobs, Epic checkpoint/merge workers, and completion review automation.
boundaries.currentOwner: Review automation and Epic merge/finalization helpers
boundaries.actorSource: Authenticated resolved reviewer decision or mechanical finalization/Epic-merge executor callback.
boundaries.authorizationAndGuards: Immutable review-lease authority and exact task/cycle/procedure/step/repository-run/candidate/base SHA correlation, with Epic completion and deployment gates.
boundaries.idempotencyIdentity: Review decision receipt or exact finalization/merge callback tuple, including review lease and repository run identities.
boundaries.replacementCommand: accept_review/return_review commands plus repository_finalization_succeeded/failed mechanical callbacks and typed Epic completion command fanout.
boundaries.phaseEMigrationDestination: Review decision command adapter and finalization procedure adapter.

instrumentation.kind: task.move payload via/source or review/finalization activity kind

boundaries.responseParity: Preserve reviewer authorization, finalization retry/no-op statuses, and repository-vs-non-repository behavior.
boundaries.sideEffectParity: Preserve immutable review decisions, repository phase updates, Epic merge/cleanup effects, queue refill, and blocker lifecycle activity.

boundaries.title: Human Epic actions affecting child workflow
boundaries.triggerSurface: Epic create/update/status/action-plan server actions that cascade or queue child tasks.
boundaries.actorSource: Authenticated browser human or PM Epic manager/reviewer principal resolved server-side.
boundaries.authorizationAndGuards: Project membership, Epic acting-manager/reviewer authority, approved-plan state, Epic status transitions, child dependency/rank rules, and expected child task versions.
boundaries.idempotencyIdentity: Epic action plus authenticated actor, Epic revision, target state, and deterministic per-child task command key.
boundaries.replacementCommand: Typed Epic command adapter with canonical child task commands; browser revalidation stays outside command transactions.
stateTouched: child Task status via transition kernel
boundaries.phaseEMigrationDestination: Epic command adapter with explicit child-task command fanout.

instrumentation.kind: task.move payload via/source or epic activity kind

boundaries.responseParity: Preserve form action results and Epic status/approval guards.
boundaries.sideEffectParity: Preserve child cascade semantics, archive-on-done, deploy review trigger, assignment, and activity rows.

boundaries.title: Work-item proposal application
boundaries.triggerSurface: Agent/human application of approved work-item proposals.
boundaries.currentOwner: Work-item proposal apply helpers and proposal API route
boundaries.actorSource: Authenticated project principal approving the proposal, with proposal ownership and project scope resolved server-side.
boundaries.authorizationAndGuards: Proposal approval authority, normalized operation validation, temporary-reference/dependency resolution, expected workflow versions, and transaction-wide command admission.
boundaries.idempotencyIdentity: Proposal id and approval revision plus deterministic operation index/temp reference and per-task command identity.
boundaries.replacementCommand: Atomic proposal batch adapter invoking transaction-capable canonical task executors; any rejection rolls back every proposal-owned write and effect.
sideEffects: activity rows for created/updated work items
boundaries.phaseEMigrationDestination: Work-item proposal command adapter that emits task/epic/subtask commands instead of direct writes.

instrumentation.kind: task.move payload via/source or proposal activity kind

boundaries.responseParity: Preserve proposal validation messages, created item summaries, and apply/reject JSON semantics.
boundaries.sideEffectParity: Preserve reference resolution, dependency guards, status transitions, activity rows, proposal status, and outbox draining.

boundaries.title: Workflow reconciler and outbox drain
boundaries.triggerSurface: Monitor reconciliation and workflow outbox delivery.
boundaries.currentOwner: Mechanical workflow reconciliation and outbox workers
boundaries.actorSource: The PM monitor/reconciler service executing recorded durable effects and invariant detectors.
boundaries.authorizationAndGuards: Reconciliation may only requeue an existing durable effect, retry an existing cancellation fence, or record an idempotent escalation; the outbox drain may only claim and settle recorded effects.
boundaries.idempotencyIdentity: Existing outbox row/dedupe key, cancellation run identity, or invariant kind plus row identity.
boundaries.replacementCommand: Mechanical callback/requeue operations only; missing workflow decisions are report-only and require a separately authenticated typed command.
boundaries.phaseEMigrationDestination: Mechanical reconciler/outbox workers with explicit typed commands for every domain repair.
boundaries.responseParity: Preserve reconciler dry-run reports, worker no-op behavior, and retry/error logging without fabricating domain decisions.
boundaries.sideEffectParity: Preserve compare-and-set outbox claims/requeues, cancellation fences, effect dispatch, and idempotent escalation evidence.

boundaries.title: Sub-task checklist actions
boundaries.triggerSurface: PM workflow add/complete/remove_subtask actions and work-item proposal subtask creation.
boundaries.actorSource: Authenticated PM workflow principal resolved to the visible task assignee or resolved reviewer for review-kind checklist rows.
boundaries.authorizationAndGuards: Task assignment/reviewer authority, approved Action Plan, task status, subtask kind ownership, completion/removal rules, and expected task identity.
boundaries.idempotencyIdentity: Task id, workflow message/action identity, subtask id or normalized text, checklist kind, and requested completion state.
boundaries.replacementCommand: add_subtask, complete_subtask, and remove_subtask TaskWorkflowCommand executors.
boundaries.phaseEMigrationDestination: Checklist command adapter used by task workflow commands.
boundaries.responseParity: Preserve workflow JSON response fields and validation for unknown/duplicate checklist rows.
boundaries.sideEffectParity: Preserve progress timestamps, minutes roll-up, activity rows, and rank ordering.
